title: Amazon PPC Lead Hunter
description: A multi-agent system that finds, qualifies, and enriches high-ticket agency leads based on tech stack and location.

full_details.problem: The client provides web development for Amazon PPC SaaS companies but needed a very specific profile: US/UK based, 50+ employees, and running on outdated WordPress sites. Finding this specific combination manually was impossible.
full_details.solution: I architected an n8n workflow that acts as a researcher. It starts with advanced Google Dorks to find candidates, then scrapes the site content to Markdown. An LLM Agent analyzes the text to verify 'Amazon PPC' services and US/UK location. Finally, it fingerprints the WordPress version and finds the CEO's LinkedIn profile for outreach.
full_details.result: Delivered a fully automated pipeline. The client now gets a daily list of 'perfect match' leads with CEO contact info and personalized outreach drafts ready to send.

title: Automated Job Hunter (CA/Tally)
description: An automated recruitment assistant that scans the web for specific niche accounting roles in Kolkata.

full_details.problem: My friend was wasting hours manually searching for specific 'Tally Accountant' and 'CA' roles in Kolkata. He needed to focus on applying, not searching.
full_details.solution: I built a workflow that hits the Google Search API for fresh job listings. It scrapes the page content and uses Gemini AI to filter out irrelevant listings, delivering a clean list of opportunities directly to him.
full_details.result: He stopped searching manually and now just wakes up to a curated list of jobs to apply to.

title: Bug Bounty Scope Scanner
description: A reconnaissance tool for ethical hackers that identifies new, self-hosted bug bounty programs automatically.

full_details.problem: As a former bug hunter, I knew the pain of finding good programs. Most hunters spend more time looking for targets than actually hacking.
full_details.solution: I automated the recon phase. This workflow runs on a schedule, finding new self-hosted programs via Google Dorks. It uses an LLM to analyze the program's scope and rules, ensuring it's a 'safe' and valid target before alerting the team.
full_details.result: My old team receives a stream of fresh, uncrowded targets to hunt on, giving them a first-mover advantage.

title: Instant AI Form Responder
description: A webhook-based system that drafts and sends hyper-personalized emails instantly after a user fills a form.

full_details.problem: A client wanted to impress leads filling out their Framer website form. Standard auto-responders felt robotic and cold.
full_details.solution: I set up a Webhook to catch the Framer form data. An AI Agent analyzes the user's specific query and writes a custom email (not a template) addressing their exact points, then sends it via Gmail immediately.
full_details.result: Leads receive a thoughtful, personalized reply within seconds of hitting submit, drastically increasing conversion rates.

title: Gym Website Lead Gen
description: A Google Maps scraper that identifies local businesses without websites for web development pitching.

full_details.problem: My client sells web development services to gyms in Kolkata but couldn't easily find which ones didn't have a website.
full_details.solution: I built an n8n workflow that scrapes Google Maps results for local gyms. It filters specifically for entries missing a 'Website' link, removes duplicates, and extracts phone numbers for the sales team.
full_details.result: Generated a highly targeted list of 500+ local gyms that actually needed the client's service.

title: 0bl1vyx Personal Agent
description: My personal 'Second Brain'. An AI agent equipped with tools to manage my life, code, and scheduling.

full_details.problem: I needed a central AI interface that knew *me*—my context, my files, and my preferences—unlike generic ChatGPT.
full_details.solution: I built a fully featured AI Agent in n8n with 'Tool Calling' capabilities. It can browse the live web, check the weather, perform complex calculations, and read/write to my personal database (Google Sheets).
full_details.result: A personalized assistant that acts as a force multiplier for my daily productivity.
